source.note: flowchart.md Empty description blocks before a separator: the first `accDescr` is followed by neither `:` nor `{`, so it is the vertex `accDescr`; the empty description block after it, before the line break, is a description block statement without text, and `:` on the next line is a vertex. Without the block, `accDescr`, a line break, and `:` is an accessibility statement (flowchart/lex-acc-descr-line-feed-before-colon).
